title: The part of this Grok Imagine clip that looks too real to be AI

Why Elon Musk called this Grok AI output beautiful
caption:
Grok Imagine is xAI's AI video and image generator. This clip shows what it can produce when pushed on visual quality, starting from nothing but a written description.

Most AI video tools leave obvious signs: odd movement, flickering edges, hands that look wrong. The reason this clip traveled so far is that those tells are much harder to spot here. Motion, lighting, and texture hold together in a way that earlier AI video simply couldn't.

The model has kept improving since this was recorded. Each version closes the gap between AI output and footage shot on a real camera.
